title: the Deep Rising Revisited
author: Dominic Galloway
blurb: Ulyana Thackeray, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
